questions.stem: This printer is ___ than the one we bought last year.

why_wrong: A : « the » est déplacé ici.

B: base form: 'than' requires a comparative.
C: superlative, incompatible with 'than'.

questions.stem: Of all the candidates, Ms. Park has ___ experience.

en.rule: 'of all / in the company' requires a superlative with 'the'.

C: the article 'the' is missing.
